policy: Only documented, reversible operations may be automated. Unknown or vendor-private settings remain read-only or are omitted.

tweaks.name: Select an existing Windows power plan
tweaks.description: Switches to a built-in plan that is already installed. It does not edit processor, boost, core-parking, sleep, or thermal limits.
tweaks.purpose: Lets a user choose a Windows-supported power policy and restore the previous active plan later.
prerequisites: AC power for performance plans on portable devices
tweaks.defaultValue: The user's currently active power plan (detected at runtime)
tweaks.recommendedValue: Balanced for general use; a performance plan only when explicitly selected and on AC power
tweaks.expectedBenefit: May change the system's power-versus-responsiveness behavior. No FPS, latency, or thermal gain is guaranteed.
tweaks.vendorDependency: None; the plan is provided by Windows/OEM firmware
tweaks.rollbackMethod: Restore the prior active plan GUID; the prior plan is exported when possible
tweaks.evidence: Microsoft powercfg supports listing, activation, export, and import of power schemes; see docs/REFERENCES.md.

tweaks.name: Change DNS resolver for one adapter
tweaks.description: Changes IPv4 DNS on one selected physical adapter only after both DHCP address assignment and automatic/DHCP DNS mode are confirmed. Static, managed, VPN, and unknown configurations are left alone.
tweaks.purpose: Allows a user to choose a resolver for name lookups; it cannot reduce the route latency to a game server by itself.
hardwareRequirements: A connected physical Ethernet or Wi-Fi adapter using DHCP
prerequisites: Verified DHCP address assignment and automatic/DHCP IPv4 DNS mode
A backup of current DNS state
tweaks.recommendedValue: Automatic/DHCP unless the user has a specific reason to select a resolver
tweaks.expectedBenefit: May affect DNS lookup speed, filtering, or privacy depending on resolver and location; no in-game ping benefit is promised.
tweaks.vendorDependency: None; VPN-managed and non-DHCP adapters are intentionally excluded
tweaks.rollbackMethod: Reset the selected adapter to DHCP-provided DNS from the transaction backup
tweaks.evidence: Microsoft documents Set-DnsClientServerAddress and -ResetServerAddresses; see docs/REFERENCES.md.

tweaks.name: Windows Game Mode
tweaks.description: Read-only status where available; opens the Windows Gaming settings page for any change.
tweaks.purpose: Lets the user inspect or change Microsoft's Game Mode setting without writing undocumented policy values.
tweaks.defaultValue: Detected when an OS interface exposes it; otherwise Unknown
tweaks.recommendedValue: Use the Windows default or test On/Off for the user's workload
tweaks.expectedBenefit: Windows says Game Mode can help stabilize frame rate depending on the game and system; results vary.
tweaks.rollbackMethod: Change the setting back in Windows Settings
tweaks.evidence: Microsoft Support: Use Game Mode while gaming on your Windows device; see docs/REFERENCES.md.

tweaks.name: Game Bar and background capture
tweaks.description: Opens Windows capture settings. The optimizer does not overwrite capture preferences or remove Game Bar.
tweaks.purpose: Allows the user to decide whether background recording is worth its resource use for their own workflow.
tweaks.defaultValue: Detected only when a supported Windows interface exposes it; otherwise Unknown
tweaks.recommendedValue: User-selected; preserve recording/streaming functionality unless the user chooses otherwise
tweaks.expectedBenefit: Disabling unused background recording may reduce capture work, but any gaming impact is workload-dependent and unmeasured.
tweaks.rollbackMethod: Restore the user's prior setting in Windows Settings
tweaks.evidence: Windows exposes capture options in Settings > Gaming; the application links to that supported UI rather than writing private registry values.

tweaks.name: Windows graphics preferences
tweaks.description: Opens Windows Graphics settings for per-game GPU preference and supported graphics options. It does not force HAGS or edit driver keys.
tweaks.purpose: Provides access to Windows-supported per-app graphics controls while preserving driver and user settings.
tweaks.recommendedValue: Per-game choice based on the system's actual adapters and user preference
tweaks.expectedBenefit: No benefit is assumed; some options are hardware-, driver-, game-, and build-dependent.
tweaks.rollbackMethod: Restore the prior per-app choice in Windows Settings
tweaks.evidence: Microsoft Support documents Windows Graphics preferences and windowed-game options; see docs/REFERENCES.md.

tweaks.name: Mouse and pointer settings
tweaks.description: Reads the current Windows pointer settings and opens the supported Mouse settings page. Polling rate is not guessed.
tweaks.purpose: Makes pointer acceleration and speed visible without changing HID, USB, or firmware configuration.
tweaks.recommendedValue: User-selected; no universal mouse speed or polling rate is recommended
tweaks.expectedBenefit: Improves transparency and supports deliberate input tuning; no latency change is asserted.
tweaks.vendorDependency: Polling-rate reporting depends on the device/vendor utility
tweaks.rollbackMethod: Restore the prior pointer options in Windows Settings
tweaks.evidence: Windows Settings is the supported user-facing control surface; device-specific polling information is not reliably available through generic WMI.

tweaks.name: Startup applications
tweaks.description: Shows discovered startup entries read-only and opens Windows Startup Apps settings for changes.
tweaks.purpose: Helps the user review startup load without silently disabling security, device, audio, or vendor utilities.
prerequisites: User review before changing an entry
tweaks.defaultValue: Current registry, startup-folder, and WMI inventory
tweaks.recommendedValue: Keep security and hardware-support applications enabled; assess each other entry individually
tweaks.expectedBenefit: May reduce sign-in/background load when an unnecessary entry is disabled; impact is not inferred from a vendor label.
tweaks.vendorDependency: Publisher detection depends on file metadata/signatures
tweaks.rollbackMethod: Re-enable the entry in Windows Settings or the application's own settings
tweaks.evidence: Windows Settings > Apps > Startup is the supported management interface.

tweaks.name: Review old user temporary files
tweaks.description: Optional preview-only cleanup of files older than seven days inside the current user's TEMP directory. System directories, shader caches, browser data, driver stores, and update files are excluded.
tweaks.purpose: Offers a narrowly scoped way to reclaim space when the user confirms the exact file count and size.
prerequisites: Explicit preview and confirmation; files may still be in use
tweaks.recommendedValue: No cleanup unless the preview shows files the user wants removed
tweaks.expectedBenefit: May reclaim disk space; it is not an FPS or latency optimization.
tweaks.rollbackMethod: Not reversible; cleanup is not included in optimization profiles and is never automatic
tweaks.evidence: Conservative file-scope policy; not a performance tweak.
